correctness.rationale: Actual multiplication gives u=A·S, v=B·T, w=(A+B)·R+det(S,T); there are q² diagonal lifts for fixed A,B. For A+B≠0, R contributes q solutions; for A+B=0 the determinant count splits according to u=v=0 and w=0. The derived formula q³M(u)M(v)+1_{u=v=0}(q^8 1_{w=0}−q^7) yields four positive strata and, after summing over w, independent U,V; half L1 deviation gives (q−1)/q^5. Independent literal matrix-pair enumeration checked every pair at q=2 and q=3, including characteristic two.
